title: Carry drop count/packet ID/queue ID as options on packet block
description:
As requested by [this comment][1] on !2859, move `drop_count`, `packet_id`, and `interface_queue` from
dedicated fields in the packet structure to block options on the packet block in
`wtap_rec.block`.

[1]: https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/2859#note_615984624

supporting them.
